subject.title: docs(release): add a release-train scope contract

question: Should every future release branch require this authoritative train issue, exact six-class taxonomy, and per-PR metadata contract?
rationale: The choice changes maintainer and agent-operated release governance, including which release-branch changes are permitted and who may approve exceptions; repository behavior cannot establish that policy decision automatically.

options.title: Shadow then adopt
options.body: Run one advisory shadow train, record classification gaps and exceptions, then revise and approve the mandatory contract from that evidence.

options.title: Keep it advisory
options.body: Document the issue template and metadata as optional planning aids without declaring them authoritative or restricting release classes.

options.title: Do not add the contract
options.body: Retain the existing SHA-pinned release process and close the PR if no release owner wants an additional governance layer.

recommendation.title: Shadow then adopt
recommendation.body: Run one advisory shadow train, record classification gaps and exceptions, then revise and approve the mandatory contract from that evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the strongest sustained ownership of the public release policy and current release verification contract.
